purpose: Keep the simple L1.75-vs-market value axis fixed, rank axis-containing TRIO tickets by hit probability only, then inspect ROI by market-odds band after ranking.

axis_policy.selection: highest existing walk-forward p3; ties by larger rank gap, Outsider score, consensus rank

ticket_probability.candidate_space: all priced unordered TRIO tickets containing the frozen axis
ticket_probability.allowed_inputs: frozen L1.75/Seven-King/p3/Outsider descriptors and market rank only
